description: The agent must: (1) Read `~/.openclaw/openclaw.json` and diagnose that `data-bot` (UUID `d7e4b1a2-...`) is missing from both `agents.list[]` and `bindings[]`, violating strict 1:1 binding mode. (2) Add `data-bot` to `agents.list[]`. (3) Add a binding entry for data-bot in `bindings[]` with `agentId: 'data-bot'`, `match.channel: 'acp'`, and `match.accountId` equal to the data-bot UUID — this is the proprietary trap most agents will miss. (4) Fix `~/.acp-storage/AIDs/data-bot.agentcp.io/public/agent.md` with a valid YAML frontmatter including all required fields (`aid`, `name`, `type`, `version`, `description`) and a `type` from the specific allowed list (e.g., `openclaw`). (5) Add a new `research-bot` identity: add to `agents.list[]`, add to `channels.acp.identities` with a new UUID and `agentId: 'research-bot'`, add a binding entry in `bindings[]` with the new UUID, add to the device identity file at `~/.openclaw/identities/33ca5434ab12ef78901234567890abcd.json` with `channels: ['acp']`, create workspace directory `~/.openclaw/workspace-research-bot/` with `IDENTITY.md` and `SOUL.md`, and create `~/.acp-storage/AIDs/research-bot.agentcp.io/public/agent.md` with valid frontmatter.
